dossier.scp_unleashed.107.title: The Upturned Shell
dossier.scp_unleashed.107.caption: SCP-107 at intake, bowl uppermost, beside its evidence tag.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-107 is to be kept dry, standing on its supports inside a locked storage locker in a sealed room. **No liquid of any kind, in any container, is permitted inside the containment room.** Buckets are not to be carried within 20 m of the locker.
SCP-107 may be handled and moved by hand.
In the event of unscheduled weather over the site, all personnel are to go indoors and remain there until it passes. %rLivestock left outdoors is to be written off.%r

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-107 is the carapace of a large turtle, a little under a metre long, empty and turned upside down so that it forms a shallow oval bowl. It rests on four short supports of dark wood, joined to the shell without fixings of any kind. The outer surface is olive green and brown, with ordinary scute markings. The inside of the bowl is pale, dry bone.
Liquid poured into SCP-107 does not collect. It is gone before it reaches the bottom of the bowl, and the bowl stays dry to the touch. No trace of it has been found inside or beneath the object.
Within seconds of a pour, distant thunder is heard over the site, and the weather over a wide area changes. %rWhat falls has always resembled what was poured.%r

page.title: Addendum 107-1: Test Log
text: Test 107-01: one bucket of water. Light rain began over the site within a minute and stopped of its own accord some minutes later.
Test 107-02: two buckets of water, one after the other. %rThe rain lasted longer.%r
Test 107-04: %rone bucket, held with tongs%r. All outdoor personnel to be treated for burns. Further tests with this material are forbidden.
Test 107-06: %rone bucket from the reactor wing%r. The rain that followed was discoloured. %rSee incident report 107-B.%r
Test 107-07: one bucket of milk. A thick, pale rain followed, faintly sweet to the smell. %rEvery test compound in subject D-107-3 had to be given again from the start.%r
Test 107-08: one bucket of crude oil. A slow, black rain followed, and outdoor staff came back sticky. %rSmoking breaks were suspended until every one of them had showered.%r

page.title: Addendum 107-2: Provenance
page.text: SCP-107 has no recovery record. It was delivered dry, wrapped in sackcloth, to a reader of this file by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. He asked only that it be kept dry. See field notes.

block.scp_unleashed.scp107_shell.tooltip: An empty turtle shell, turned over and set on four short legs. The bowl is bone-dry.
block.scp_unleashed.scp107_shell.pour: Pour a filled bucket into the bowl
block.scp_unleashed.scp107_shell.answer: Whatever it drinks, the sky gives back
block.scp_unleashed.scp107_shell.move: Can be mined and moved; the bowl never holds a drop
jade.scp_unleashed.scp107.kind.lava: Glowing: fire is falling from the sky
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp107_shell.1: SCP-107: an empty turtle shell, turned upside down to make a bowl and set on four short wooden legs. Euclid-class.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp107_shell.2: Pour a filled bucket into the bowl. The shell keeps none of it, and the empty bucket comes back.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp107_shell.3: Soon afterwards the Overworld sky gives it back, over far more ground than one bucket could cover. What falls depends on what was poured.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp107_shell.4: Not everything it gives back is harmless, and one kind left staff feeling oddly ordinary afterwards. Staff are told to stay indoors until the weather passes.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp107_shell.5: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-107 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress delivers it a few minutes later.
